origin.birthplace: Claims to come from a monastery in the north. Actually from Saltmarsh
origin.socialStatus: A wandering pilgrim and preacher, lives on alms
origin.profession: Wandering preacher, teller of parables and miracle stories

appearance.face: A meek, kind face, a broad smile, "good" eyes
appearance.hairAndEyes: Light brown hair, short beard, blue eyes
appearance.clothing: A simple grey pilgrim's cloak, a staff, a wooden medallion of a saint
appearance.gestures: Blesses everyone; touches the medallion when he exaggerates
appearance.firstImpression: A good-natured, holy man anyone would confess to
appearance.artistNotes: The wooden medallion is worn smooth from touching; under the cloak he wears fine leather boots that do not suit his humble look.

backstory.biography: Robin grew up in Saltmarsh, the son of a poor washerwoman. He learned early that people give more to a holy man than to a poor child. He put on a pilgrim's cloak and took to the roads telling parables and miracle stories. His faith is half real, half role, and he has long stopped knowing which half is larger.
backstory.whyHere: Money and an audience. The table is full of people with something to lose who need someone to comfort them.
backstory.secret: That he is from Saltmarsh, that he loves comfort more than he preaches, and that sometimes he believes his own stories.

psychology.weakness: Believes his own stories far too much
psychology.desire: To live richly and still be loved like a saint

behavior.alliances: Makes them easily, betrays them easily
behavior.whenAttacks: When the victim is emotionally vulnerable

motives.hiddenGoal: To win the trust and money of the richest, most frightened person at the table
motives.betrayalTrigger: Always, if a bigger victim appears

speech.howLies: With full conviction and exaggerated sincerity
speech.angerAndFear: Anger comes out as "holy wrath"; when afraid he prays

mechanics.strangeness: The candles near him burn brighter when he lies, and dimmer when he tells the truth.
mechanics.temptation: Believes his own stories far too much
mechanics.ability: Blessing: once per evening he turns away one gift sent to him, without a door.
mechanics.hostRelation: Ignorance — he believes he can convert the host.

authorNotes.distinctive: A charming hypocrite in a saint's robes. You never know when he believes and when he plays.
authorNotes.immutable: The hypocrisy, the charm and the blessings.
authorNotes.tunable: How convincing he is and how easily he is unmasked.

lines.text: Peace be with you, brothers and sisters. I am only a humble traveller.
A blessing! Heaven was with me.
God's will. I accept it humbly.
How could… I am only a poor pilgrim!
An alliance is a sacred thing, brother.
I shall pray for your soul.
Brother Robin, a pilgrim. He has visited every shrine in the kingdom… at least in his stories.
Peace be with you again, brother. Heaven brings us together once more.
Now… I will find out… whether it was true.

tells.description: Touches his wooden medallion when he exaggerates
